department: Faculty of Social Science — Department of Psychology (Neuropsychology and Cognition)

deadline.value: Main Round and HKPFS application deadline for 2027-28 entry is December 1, 2026 (Clearing Round: March 31, 2027).

gre_subject.value: Department of Psychology and CUHK Graduate School programme pages do not state a GRE Subject Test in Psychology requirement.

supervisor.value: Applicants must clearly indicate their potential supervisor in the heading of their personal statement.
supervisor.quote: Remarks: Please clearly indicate the potential supervisor in the heading of a statement.

funding.value: All full-time MPhil and PhD students receive studentships (HK$229,200/yr standard GS rate in 2026-27) provided they remain in good academic standing.
funding.quote: All our full-time M.Phil. and Ph.D. students receive some form of studentships, as long as they are in good academic standing.

also.quote: Annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$229,200 (approx. US$29,400). Payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits applicants holding a Bachelor's degree in Psychology or a related field as well as Master's holders.
entry_route.quote: possess a Bachelor's degree in Psychology or in a related field;

notes: Department of Psychology covers Neuropsychology and Cognition alongside Developmental, Health/Clinical, and Social Psychology. Neuroscience PhD research is also conducted in the School of Biomedical Sciences (Neural, Vascular, and Metabolic Biology theme, under biomed) and Department of Medicine & Therapeutics (PhD in Medical Sciences).
